title: Safeguards for foreign AI and data analytics vendors handling citizen data
asked: Mr Low asked whether the whole-of-Government data architecture allows foreign-headquartered proprietary AI or data analytics platforms to process citizen data, and what legal and technical safeguards prevent foreign governments from compelling disclosure under their domestic laws.
response: Ms Jasmin Lau said the Government uses international vendors and applies risk-based safeguards: access on a needs-basis, non-retention, encryption, access and identity management, possible data residency, and contractual and governance controls. These are intended to prevent vendors from accessing, using or disclosing government data where not permitted, including in response to foreign government demands. She added that some jurisdictions, such as the US, may have extraterritorial laws that override contracts, so the Government also relies on technical controls and governance frameworks.

key_points.point: The Government uses best-in-class technology solutions, including from international vendors.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: the Government uses best-in-class technology solutions, including those from international vendors

key_points.point: Data access is granted strictly on a needs-basis following the principle of least privilege.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: data access is granted strictly on a "needs-basis" following the principle of least privilege

key_points.point: Vendors are expected to implement technical safeguards including non-retention of data, encryption, and access and identity management.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: Vendors are expected to implement robust technical safeguards such as non-retention of data, encryption as well as access and identity management.

key_points.point: Data residency may be required depending on the sensitivity of the data.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: Data residency may also be required, depending on the sensitivity of the data.

key_points.point: Governance frameworks and contractual agreements cover how data can be accessed, used, stored and retained.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: proper governance frameworks and contractual agreements on how the data can be accessed, used, stored and retained

key_points.point: These measures help prevent vendors from accessing, using or disclosing government data where not permitted, including in response to foreign government demands.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: These help to prevent vendors from accessing, using or disclosing government data where they are not permitted to do so, including in response to demands from foreign governments.

key_points.point: The Government continuously monitors vendor compliance, conducts regular security assessments and updates its frameworks.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: We continuously monitor vendor compliance, conduct regular security assessments and update our frameworks

key_points.point: A separate Parliamentary Question on Palantir for the Ministry of Finance will be left for MOF to answer.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: the Member may have filed a separate Parliamentary Question on Palantir for the Ministry of Finance (MOF), which I will leave for MOF to answer

key_points.point: Some jurisdictions, such as the US, may have legislation or regulations with extraterritorial reach that require companies to provide certain information.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: some jurisdictions like, as he mentioned, the US, may have legislation or regulations, including with extraterritorial reach, that empower government agencies to require companies or entities within their jurisdictions to provide certain information

key_points.point: Such legislation or regulations can override contractual obligations.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: Such legislation or regulations can override contractual obligations.

key_points.point: The Government relies not solely on contractual provisions but also on other risk mitigation measures such as technical controls, safeguards and governance frameworks.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: the Government's approach is to rely not solely on contractual provisions, but also on other risk mitigation measures

left_open: Whether the whole-of-Government data architecture permits foreign-headquartered proprietary AI or data analytics platforms to process citizen data.
The specific legal safeguards that ensure data cannot be compelled for disclosure under a foreign government's domestic laws.
Whether there are ongoing contracts with Palantir Technologies.
